citation: Vaara JP, et al. 2018. 60-Hour Sleep Deprivation Affects Submaximal but Not Maximal Physical Performance. Frontiers in Physiology 9:1437.
protocol: 60 h continuous sleep deprivation; cardiorespiratory and lactate testing before and after (submaximal loads 100-250 W; blood lactate at 8 min at 275 W)
population: n=20 male military cadets (age 26 +/- 2 y, height 1.77 m, body mass 79.6 +/- 11.1 kg)

reports.where: Results text, pre vs post mean HR, max HR
Results text, PRE vs POST blood lactate

note: Within-subject pre vs post comparison; the sleep schedule is total deprivation (60 h) with no sleep-time values per night. Values are mean +/- SD as in the text. Heart rate and blood lactate only.
